item.title: viebBook 2.6.11
item.description: Exercise filters now open beside the filter button instead of replacing the reader. The compact light/dark popover includes progress and correctness segments, difficulty/type/keyword menus, a live result count and reset. Classic layout remains compatible. Verified with 13 targeted filter and native UI checks. SHA-256: `de39defcae4a95429677f3e9e91247f9f8748d78f54814ab89df49eabdfbcd2e`

item.title: viebBook 2.6.10
item.description:
Drawing previews now have no bright outline, including the background image edge. Dark canvases use the cooler app gray. The page theme is applied before parsing and the native drawing host starts with the same background, removing the white-to-dark flash. Stored artwork and original images stay unchanged.
Mac2.6.10. Seventeen targeted tests passed, including actual WebKit initial-parser theme state and drawing/save checks.
SHA-256: `2a87067fa7d8b6c2747f0b24670674d9ab478c3ed7d734ab17b68b510b02e914`

item.title: viebBook 2.6.9
item.description:
Drawings now stay within their background frame when drawing or moving shapes. Previews use the saved canvas proportions without the extra bottom strip. The drawing canvas and preview follow the book page theme, while stored artwork stays unchanged. Publisher QR codes in book content are smaller; QR invoices retain their size.
Mac 2.6.9. Thirteen targeted document and real WebKit drawing tests passed.
SHA-256: `b4c2d6604b1fe294199ef4e6499f41d02356f059b860b3ad3c2f46b0354a26c4`

item.title: viebBook 2.6.8
item.description:
The pairing sheet has a cleaner fixed layout with aligned network, address and code details and copy controls. The whole Weitere Optionen row now toggles instantly. QR pixels stay cached when options or hover state change, and generation runs off the main actor. Small windows keep scrolling and content padding.
QR payload, error correction and quiet zone are unchanged. Close or Escape cancels pairing. Mac release 2.6.8. Forty pairing/security tests and two native QR/presentation tests passed, including full-row clicks, fixed dimensions, rendered QR decoding, light/dark layouts and short-window scrolling.

item.title: viebBook 2.6.7
item.description:
Settings use shorter labels and clarify that viebBook must remain open on the Mac during sync. Newly paired devices show a concise pending-sync status.
Includes the 2.6.6 AI panel fix: login status and model lists stay cached across Settings and chat-panel visits, concurrent lookups are shared, and failed refreshes keep the last good result. Prüfen explicitly refreshes the connection.
Release publishing now authenticates GitHub metadata requests to avoid anonymous shared-runner rate limits. Mac 2.6.7, build 362. Six focused AI cache and sync-copy tests passed.
